title: Simplicial model compatibility tested on generators
statement: Use model categories, weak factorization systems, functorial factorizations, cofibrant and fibrant objects as defined in [lem-coef-simplicial-boundary-collapse-test], simplicial tensors and cotensors as defined in [def-coef-simplicial-tensor-cotensor], and the Kan model structure of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. Enlarge universes so the categories and localizations below exist as ordinary categories. Let $\mathcal M$ have a model structure and the indicated compatible enrichment, tensors and cotensors, without initially assuming the simplicial model axiom. Let $S,T$ be sets of arrows such that $S^{\square}=F\cap W$ and $T^{\square}=F$, where right orthogonality means having fillers in every lifting square. For $c:A\to B$ and $b:K\to L$ put $c\square b=(L\otimes A)\amalg_{K\otimes A}(K\otimes B)\to L\otimes B$. Suppose for every monomorphism $b$ of simplicial sets that $s\square b$ is a cofibration for every $s\in S$, trivial if $b$ is weak, and $t\square b$ is a trivial cofibration for every $t\in T$. Then $c\square b$ is a cofibration for every cofibration $c$ and monomorphism $b$, trivial if either $c$ or $b$ is weak. Equivalently, the specified enrichment, tensors and cotensors satisfy the simplicial model axiom: the corner map of mapping simplicial sets for a cofibration and a fibration is a Kan fibration, trivial if either arrow is weak. No cofibrancy of the domains of $S,T$ is assumed.

proof.text: For $b:K\to L$ and $p:X\to Y$ form $q_b(p):X^L\to X^K\times_{Y^K}Y^L$ with components restriction along $b$ and postcomposition with $p$. The pullback exists because $\mathcal M$ is complete. The tensor/cotensor adjunction in [def-coef-simplicial-tensor-cotensor], on vertices, gives $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal M}(K\otimes A,X)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal M}(A,X^K)$, natural in all variables. Apply [lem-coef-parametrized-adjunction-corner-lifting] with $H(K,A)=K\otimes A$, $R(K,X)=X^K$, and arrows $(b,c,p)$. Its pushout corner is exactly $c\square b$ and its pullback corner is $q_b(p)$. Thus $(c\square b)\perp p$ if and only if $c\perp q_b(p)$. This uses a parametrized adjunction, not the simplicial model axiom.

source.place: Paragraph 2, derived coefficient adjunction; agent-supplied ordinary simplicial-model prerequisite in the existing projective-model-calculus ancestry. Explicit generator extension via parametrized corner lifting.

proof.text: Fix a monomorphism $b$ and $p\in F\cap W$. For every $s\in S$, the assumed cofibration $s\square b$ lifts against $p$, by the weak factorization system $(C,F\cap W)$ of [lem-coef-simplicial-boundary-collapse-test]. Step 1 says $s\perp q_b(p)$. Therefore $q_b(p)\in S^{\square}=F\cap W$. Every $c\in C$ lifts against this map; applying step 1 again gives $(c\square b)\perp p$. Since $p$ was arbitrary in $F\cap W$, the equality $C={}^{\square}(F\cap W)$ proves $c\square b\in C$.

source.place: Paragraph 2, derived coefficient adjunction; agent-supplied ordinary simplicial-model prerequisite in the existing projective-model-calculus ancestry. Explicit generator extension via parametrized corner lifting.

proof.text: If the monomorphism $b$ is also weak, take any $p\in F$. Each assumed trivial cofibration $s\square b$, $s\in S$, lifts against $p$ by $(C\cap W,F)$ in [lem-coef-simplicial-boundary-collapse-test]. Step 1 now gives $q_b(p)\in S^{\square}=F\cap W$. Every cofibration $c$ lifts against $q_b(p)$, so step 1 gives $(c\square b)\perp p$. Varying $p\in F$ and using ${}^{\square}F=C\cap W$ proves $c\square b\in C\cap W$.

source.place: Paragraph 2, derived coefficient adjunction; agent-supplied ordinary simplicial-model prerequisite in the existing projective-model-calculus ancestry. Explicit generator extension via parametrized corner lifting.

proof.text: For any monomorphism $b$ and any $p\in F$, the assumed trivial cofibrations $t\square b$, $t\in T$, lift against $p$ by [lem-coef-simplicial-boundary-collapse-test]. Step 1 gives $q_b(p)\in T^{\square}=F$. Hence every trivial cofibration $c\in C\cap W$ lifts against $q_b(p)$; step 1 gives $(c\square b)\perp p$. Since $p$ ranges over all fibrations, $c\square b\in{}^{\square}F=C\cap W$. Together with steps 2 and 3 this proves every asserted pushout-product case. The argument uses only the two stated right orthogonality equalities; it never imposes a condition on the domains of $S$ or $T$.

source.place: Paragraph 2, derived coefficient adjunction; agent-supplied ordinary simplicial-model prerequisite in the existing projective-model-calculus ancestry. Explicit generator extension via parametrized corner lifting.

proof.text: For $c:A\to B$ and $p:X\to Y$ let $m(c,p):\operatorname{Map}(B,X)\to\operatorname{Map}(A,X)\times_{\operatorname{Map}(A,Y)}\operatorname{Map}(B,Y)$. The tensor adjunction of [def-coef-simplicial-tensor-cotensor], on vertices, gives the natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal M}(K\otimes A,X)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{sSet}}(K,\operatorname{Map}(A,X))$. Apply [lem-coef-parametrized-adjunction-corner-lifting] with $H(A,K)=K\otimes A$ and $R(A,X)=\operatorname{Map}(A,X)$ to $(c,b,p)$. The pushout is $(K\otimes B)\amalg_{K\otimes A}(L\otimes A)$, canonically the pushout in the item with its summands interchanged: maps out of either are the same agreeing pair. The corner maps therefore coincide under this identification. It follows that $(c\square b)\perp p$ if and only if $b\perp m(c,p)$.

source.place: Paragraph 2, derived coefficient adjunction; agent-supplied ordinary simplicial-model prerequisite in the existing projective-model-calculus ancestry. Explicit generator extension via parametrized corner lifting.

proof.text: Let $c$ be a cofibration and $p$ a fibration. For a horn inclusion $b$, [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper] makes $b$ a trivial cofibration of simplicial sets. Step 3 makes $c\square b$ a trivial cofibration, so it lifts against $p$ by [lem-coef-simplicial-boundary-collapse-test]. Step 5 gives the horn lifting property for $m(c,p)$; the Kan characterization in [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper] makes it a Kan fibration. If $c$ is weak, step 4 gives the same lifting for every boundary inclusion $b$. If $p$ is weak, step 2 makes $c\square b$ a cofibration, which lifts against $p$. In either case step 5 and the boundary characterization, including dimension zero, make $m(c,p)$ a trivial Kan fibration.

source.place: Paragraph 2, derived coefficient adjunction; agent-supplied ordinary simplicial-model prerequisite in the existing projective-model-calculus ancestry. Explicit generator extension via parametrized corner lifting.

proof.text: Conversely assume the mapping-space formulation. For a cofibration $c$, monomorphism $b$ and trivial fibration $p$ of $\mathcal M$, the corner $m(c,p)$ is a trivial Kan fibration. Since monomorphisms are the cofibrations in [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper], $b\perp m(c,p)$; step 5 gives $(c\square b)\perp p$. The lifting characterization in [lem-coef-simplicial-boundary-collapse-test] proves $c\square b$ is a cofibration. If $c$ is weak, the same argument applies to every fibration $p$, since $m(c,p)$ is then trivial. If $b$ is weak, it lifts against the Kan fibration $m(c,p)$ for every fibration $p$. Step 5 then puts $c\square b$ in ${}^{\square}F=C\cap W$ in both cases. This proves the claimed equivalence.

lean.statement: theorem simplicial_sm7_generator_extension {M : Type u} [Category.{v} M] [ModelCategory M] [HasLimitsOfSize.{max v w, max v w} M] [HasColimitsOfSize.{max v w, max v w} M] [HasFunctorialFactorization (cofibrations M) (trivialFibrations M)] [HasFunctorialFactorization (trivialCofibrations M) (fibrations M)] [SimplicialCategory M] (D : SimplicialTensorCotensor M) (S T : MorphismProperty M) (hS : S.rlp = trivialFibrations M) (hT : T.rlp = fibrations M) (hSprod : ∀ {A B : M} {K L : SSet.{v}} (s : A ⟶ B) (b : K ⟶ L), S s → Mono b → ∃ q : pushout (D.parameterMap b A) (D.tensorMap K s) ⟶ D.tensor L B, D.IsPushoutProduct s b q ∧ Cofibration q ∧ (SSet.Enhanced.IsWeakHomotopyEquivalence b → WeakEquivalence q)) (hTprod : ∀ {A B : M} {K L : SSet.{v}} (t : A ⟶ B) (b : K ⟶ L), T t → Mono b → ∃ q : pushout (D.parameterMap b A) (D.tensorMap K t) ⟶ D.tensor L B, D.IsPushoutProduct t b q ∧ trivialCofibrations M q) : D.SatisfiesPushoutProductAxiom ∧ (D.SatisfiesPushoutProductAxiom ↔ SimplicialModelLocalization.SatisfiesSM7 M)
